title: Two Keys, One Order
prompt:
**Scenario.** Jobs (t_i, d_i): process all; minimize the maximum of (finish time − deadline). Which sort key has a correct exchange proof?

**Which approach is the best fit? The program only needs to print the letter.**

**A)** Shortest processing time first

**B)** Earliest deadline first (swap-adjacent exchange shows EDS never worsens max lateness)

**C)** Largest deadline first

**D)** Any order works — max lateness is order-independent

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Classic exchange: swapping two adjacent out-of-EDE-order jobs never increases the max lateness, so EDS is optimal. Shortest-first ignores deadlines entirely.
